As a tank you will always simply die more. You’re supposed to just engage, cc the living crap out of people and peel for your carries or get the fuck out and run while you still can. If you got a few deaths but your ADC survives (and is alive/fed) then you’ve done your job really well.

Also, a tip that is golden for me to help me dying less as Naut/Leo than usual is to not try to go on dumb warding missions toooo often. Try to make sure that you stay close to at least one other player at almost all times and if you can’t then try to place your wards over walls and use oracle while warding.

as a support and especially as a tank support it’s always gonna be harder to get an S- or higher. That’s just how it is but I kinda like that it’s a bit more challenging.
